subject: Names of colours in the default scheme

messages.author: c772b04b49d59fba
messages.subject: Names of colours in the default scheme
parts:
I am making a graph in which different lines are coloured using a
particular discrete variable that takes three values. I am using the
default theme. The three lines are coloured in shades of red, blue and
green. I would like to add textual annotations to the graph using
geom_text, but using the same font colours as the colours of the
lines. Can someone tell me how to find names of these colours?

Vikas

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: Names of colours in the default scheme
parts:
Hi Vikas,
I think the usual way to do it is to set the colour of the text the
same way you set the colour of the lines (i.e., as an aesthetic
mapping). The advantage of this approach is that if you change the
colour scale (e.g., with scale_colour_hue() your changes will be
consistent across all geoms using that scale.

Best,
Ista
